item.title: Mennonite congregations protest at Target, call for ICE defunding
item.description: Mennonite congregations gathered at a Goshen Target Saturday to sing hymns and protest federal immigration enforcement.

item.title: These Super Bowl hopefuls have Indiana collegiate connections
item.description: Four players and one coach for the New England Patriots and Seattle Seahawks have collegiate connections to the state.

item.title: Indiana's 2026 primary: Who's running for congressional and legislative seats
item.description: This year, all nine U.S. House seats, all 100 Indiana House seats and half of the 50 Indiana Senate seats will be on ballots.

item.title: The cost of ICE arrests: Immigrants paying more for bond
item.description: Immigration arrests have become more common under the Trump administration, and the financial strain has increased for immigrants in jail.

item.title: After Hailey Buzbee’s death, lawmakers introduce amendments aimed at protecting teens
item.description: After Hailey Buzbee’s death, lawmakers introduce amendments aimed at protecting teens. One would update the state’s alert system while another revives social media protections.

item.title: ‘We are losing the fight’: Indiana pushes tougher social media rules for kids
item.description: Indiana lawmakers are now considering giving parents greater control over their children’s social media accounts and requiring social media companies to redesign their platforms to be less addictive for kids.

item.title: Indiana bans driver’s license gender changes despite public pushback
item.description: The rule, effective Feb. 12, will end a longstanding legal option for transgender and gender diverse residents to modify their identification cards through a physician statement or court order.

item.title: Can a $50 billion rural health program make up for massive federal cuts to health care?
item.description: A new federal project called the Rural Health Transformation Program was designed to address health deserts in rural communities. What is it, and what impact could it have in Indiana?

item.title: Martindale Brightwood residents call on Mayor Hogsett to stop data center development
item.description: They are urging Mayor Joe Hogsett to stop a proposed 14-acre data center ahead of a critical rezoning hearing Feb. 12.

item.title: Army of volunteers aim to make one million meals for food banks at annual event
item.description: Volunteers gathered Tuesday at Gainbridge Fieldhouse for the Million Meal Marathon, an annual event to help address food insecurity across the state.
